lbzip2_env_args.description: List of string arguments to prepend via LBZIP2/BZIP2 environment variables.

lbzip2_args.description: List of string arguments to append directly to the command line.

lbzip2_threads.description: Number of threads to use. 0 means auto-detect. Corresponds to -n.

lbzip2_compression_level.description: Compression level from 1 to 9. Corresponds to -1 through -9.

lbzip2_small.description: Reduce memory usage at cost of performance. Corresponds to -s.

lbzip2_sequential.description: Perform splitting input blocks sequentially. Corresponds to -u.

lbzip2_force.description: Force mode, overwrite existing files. Corresponds to -f.

lbzip2_keep.description: Don't remove input files after compression/decompression. Corresponds to -k.

lbzip2_stdout.description: Write output to standard output. Corresponds to -c.

lbzip2_test.description: Test decompression; discard output. Corresponds to -t.

lbzip2_files.description: List of file operands to compress or decompress.
